title: Flamenco backstage.
text: This is the inside of Flamenco. A high energy, behind the scenes exhibition. Multiple dancers, singers and guitarists. Over an hour of excitement. Do not miss it.
author: gerrypp

title: Amazing dance class in the center of Sevilla
text: I booked a Sevillanas class with Eva with the Feria a few weeks away, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Eva is a great teacher. I booked one more class just to make sure I have all 4 pasos down pat.
author: MBS2015t

title: Review from Belgium
text: The people there were super friendly. I had seen flamenco before, but it is so nice to get to know it this way. You get a behind the scenes look at this incredibly difficult and beautiful dance! Definitely worth passing if you are near Seville. There was not only dance, but also live singing, clapping and guitar playing. Super fun!
author: myrac406
